exclusion_reason: Implemented but red because the full FIX-005 raster set — clip regions, real font glyph metrics beyond the stock glyph, DIB section transfer, and the browser present path with its invalidation trace — is not served, and no committed image-golden fixture is compared on the declared browser profile. The GDI 2D slice exists generically in lib/gdi.mjs over one bounded RGBA surface per DC: stock and created pen/brush/palette objects, SelectObject/DeleteObject, SetPixel/GetPixel, MoveToEx/LineTo (Bresenham), Rectangle, FillRect and PatBlt (pattern-copy and the black/white ops, refusing an unrealized ternary op), BitBlt/StretchBlt, TextOutW over the stock glyph, the SetTextColor/SetBkColor/SetBkMode state, SetROP2/GetROP2, GetDeviceCaps over one declared virtual-display profile, and the palette realize/nearest-index path.
promotion_trigger: Promote when FIX-005 produces the expected raster and API trace on the declared browser profile.
expected_failing_assertion: Clip regions, real font metrics, DIB transfer, and the browser present/invalidation path are absent, so the full FIX-005 raster cannot be produced.
active_gate_evidence: Two conformance suites carry a case for every served GDI32 export (served gdi32 surface 22 to 27): the subsystem suite in test/gdi.test.mjs and the core-HLE suite; the draw fixture regresses the rendered surface against a test-time reference, and a dedicated test proves PatBlt fills the region with the selected brush, the black/white ops paint their color, GetDeviceCaps reports the declared display, and SetROP2/GetROP2 round-trip. The full suite stays green.
procedure: Render bitmap, text, palette, clip, brush, pen, font, and invalidation cases.
Compare pixel output and call trace under the declared font and color profile.
pass_criterion: Every image region is inside the approved tolerance.
Unsupported raster behavior returns a precise capability error.
